topics.title: Objection: Answer Nahi, Diagnose
topics.narration: Prospect: “Mujhe sochna hai.” Bad: “Sure sir, kab call karun?” But “think” could mean price, value, spouse, fear, comparison, self-doubt, implementation, genuine processing, polite rejection. “Of course. Exactly kis part ke baare mein aapko sochna hai?” If prospect identifies something: diagnose it. If they genuinely need space: respect it. “Diagnosis ka goal har objection ko destroy karna nahi. Goal clarity create karna hai.”

topics.title: Buying Signals + Stop Over-Selling
topics.narration: Buying signal ka matlab hamesha: “I am buying.” nahi hota. It may indicate a shift from: “Should I buy?” toward: “If I buy, what happens?” Common signals: price/payment questions, EMI, start date, onboarding, implementation, support, delivery, exact plan/version, accountability, future-tense ownership language. “Meri team ko kaise onboard karoge?” This is stronger than: “Aapka product kaise kaam karta hai?”

topics.title: Price Confidence
topics.narration: Before price: calm, normal, conversational. After price: speed increases, voice changes, justification starts. “Prospect ne objection diya bhi nahi—and closer already objection handle kar raha hai.” You may literally create doubt that wasn’t there. “Closer anxiety is not a prospect objection.” State Price → Pause → Observe → Diagnose Actual Reaction “Sir, investment ₹60,000 plus GST hai.” Then let prospect respond. If useful in that context: “Kya ye us range ke around hai jo aapne mind mein sochi thi?” The purpose is information, not awkward guessing. “Agli call mein price bolne ke baad consciously 2–3 seconds ka pause rakho.” Don’t rescue the silence. Just observe. “State the price. Stay the same person.”

topics.title: Pain / Impact Quantification
topics.narration: 1. MONEY Ask: “Roughly iska financial impact kitna hai?” Possible: missed revenue, wasted spend, extra cost, missed profit. 2. TIME “Is problem pe aap personally ya team kitna extra time spend kar rahi hai?” 10–15 founder hours/week. 3. EFFORT “Kitna manual work ya repeated effort lag raha hai?” rework, coordination, management burden. 4. EMOTIONAL IMPACT Relevant ho tab: “Mentally iska kitna stress/frustration hai?” But don't force it. 5. OPPORTUNITY “Agar ye problem na hoti, wo time/money/capacity kahan use hoti?” Could mean: missed deals, delayed scale, strategy, family/personal time, another growth opportunity.
